title: Identifying and disentangling direct and spillover effects using multiple pre-treatment periods
abstract: arXiv:2610.37049v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Under interference, the treatment of some units affects the outcomes of others, so that the effect on a treated unit consists of a direct and a spillover component. A non-treated comparison group then generally identifies neither component, but the difference between the total effect on the treated and the spillover effect on the comparison units. We show that both components are identified separately when multiple pre-treatment periods are available, without an uncontaminated comparison group. Under no anticipation, pre-treatment outcomes are free of both components for every unit. Extrapolating the pre-treatment trend within a group, as in interrupted time series approaches, therefore identifies the counterfactual outcome in the absence of any treatment. translated_title: 利用多个处理前时期识别并分离直接效应与溢出效应
translated_abstract: 在存在干扰的情况下，某些单位的处理会影响其他单位的结果，因此对一个被处理单位的效应由直接效应和溢出效应两部分组成。此时，未处理的对照组通常无法识别其中任何一个组成部分，而只能识别被处理单位的总效应与对照单位溢出效应之间的差异。我们证明，当拥有多个处理前时期的数据时，即使没有未被污染的对照组，这两个组成部分也可以被分别识别。在无预期假设下，每个单位的处理前结果均不包含这两个成分。因此，如同中断时间序列方法那样，对组内处理前趋势进行外推，即可识别出在没有任何处理情形下的反事实结果。将其应用于被处理单位可得到它们的总效应，应用于处于给定暴露水平的未处理单位则可得到它们的溢出效应。
tldr: 本文证明在存在干扰的情形下，利用多个处理前时期的数据，即使缺乏未受污染的对照组，也能分别识别并分离出处理效应中的直接效应与溢出效应。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that, under interference, direct and spillover effects can be separately identified and disentangled using multiple pre-treatment periods, even without an uncontaminated comparison group.
